Your degree workspace

1. Choose your destination

Set the actual program total and credit system from its catalog. This workspace does not automatically convert credit systems.

2. Add what you've earned

Import an inventory

CSV inventories stay in your browser. PDF transcript interpretation is not available in this release. Imported credits start unevaluated.

3. Make the tradeoffs yours

Enter your own tuition quote, pace, fees, alternative-credit costs and housing costs. Calculations are scenarios, not school prices or graduation promises.

4. Your action checklist

A CLEARER PATH, STEP BY STEP

Understand the system.
Make it work for you.

01

Collect your experience.

Bring together college courses, exams, military training, certifications and prior learning. Avoid repeating learning you've already completed.

02

Match before you spend.

ACE and NCCRS recommend credit; they do not accredit colleges or guarantee acceptance. Get written confirmation of the exact course equivalency and degree requirement before paying.

03

Follow your approved plan.

Check major, upper-level, prerequisite, residency and credit-age rules. Confirm course availability, then track your progress with your school's advisor.
